question: Can universal exactness C_R=1 be decided by all four-arm subset matchings in O(n^4), although the present exact-factor algorithm enumerates all subsets?
domain: Every one of the existing 1337 controlled ranking/slot instances, including all 720 six-arm orders; no new endpoint generation or selection.
check: Compute restricted/free matching costs for every disjoint pair P,Q of size2. Compare the all-quartet exactness Boolean with independently saved full-subset C_R=1. Keep nonunit witness quartets and count any full-factor value greater than the maximum quartet ratio, without assuming equality of the nonunit constants.
scope: A zero-loss decision criterion using standard one-dimensional assignment uncrossing, not a new generic matching algorithm or a polynomial algorithm for nonunit C_R.
